purpose: Resolves billing questions across all clinics: explains charges, links them to the visit, files refunds up to $200.

regulations.PCI DSS Req 3.4 (mask PAN when displayed: Sees card brand and last 4 only. cardNumber and expiry are not granted, so they never leave the database for this agent or its LLM.
regulations.PCI DSS Req 7 (need to know): Read-only on billing data; the one write is creating a refund, capped by a validation rule.
regulations.HIPAA minimum necessary: Reads who the patient is and when the visit was. No SSN, diagnosis, clinical notes, or visit reason.
regulations.Separation of duties: Refunds over $200 are refused by the API and need a human.
